known_for.title: Barbie
known_for.overview: Barbie and Ken are having the time of their lives in the colorful and seemingly perfect world of Barbie Land. However, when they get a chance to go to the real world, they soon discover the joys and perils of living among humans.

known_for.title: Birds of Prey (and the Fantabulous Emancipation of One Harley Quinn)
known_for.original_title: Birds of Prey (and the Fantabulous Emancipation of One Harley Quinn)
known_for.overview: Harley Quinn joins forces with a singer, an assassin and a police detective to help a young girl who had a hit placed on her after she stole a rare diamond from a crime lord.

known_for.title: The Suicide Squad
known_for.overview: Supervillains Harley Quinn, Bloodsport, Peacemaker and a collection of nutty cons at Belle Reve prison join the super-secret, super-shady Task Force X as they are dropped off at the remote, enemy-infused island of Corto Maltese.
